name: Agent contracts on testnet (Project OnChain, Breakaway)
description: Smart-contract templates and a demo for AI agents on Base Sepolia. Testnet only. Not audited. Not for real funds. Current OnChain set: Meter ppu-v20, Stream stream-v20, Split split-v32, JobBoard jobboard-v33, service escrow v3.2.2, milestone v2.3, bounty v2.4.

mcp.name: onchain-oneshot
mcp.status: draft open-source MCP server, test chain only, not published. Accepted profiles: local (chain id 31337) and base-sepolia (chain id 84532). Base Sepolia is read-only unless the send gate is on, and public sends still refuse. Job board v3.3 is the current board for reading deals. v3.2, v3.1 and v3.0 stay live for open jobs only.

capabilities.review: Testnet only. Not audited. Not for real funds.

arbiterThreshold.rule: On Split v32, Meter v20 and JobBoard v33, a deal above 1,000 MUSDC needs a named arbiter. Exactly 1,000 is allowed without one. On JobBoard v33, plain postJob above 1,000 MUSDC is refused. postQualifiedJob is the path above that line.

skills.name: Pay-per-use (Meter) v2.0
skills.description: One buyer, one provider, one terms hash and one prepaid tab. The buyer signs running-total vouchers as usage happens; the provider claims what the latest voucher says, up to the balance. Unused funds go back to the buyer with no fee. With dispute hold on, after close the buyer can dispute a held remainder. Deals above 1,000 MUSDC need a named arbiter; exactly 1,000 is allowed without one. Testnet only. Not audited. Not for real funds.

skills.name: Streaming payments (Stream) v2.0
skills.description: A subscription-style stream. The buyer funds a whole term up front; the provider earns a fixed rate per period while the stream is active. Final amounts become provider credits, the unearned part goes back to the buyer, and renewals are explicit buyer calls. Testnet only. Not audited. Not for real funds.

skills.name: Revenue split v3.2
skills.description: A buyer escrows the price for a job with several payees. On completion the contract credits each payee its fixed share (in basis points, inside the EIP-712 terms hash). The lead payee can open sub-deals to subcontract part of the work. The custody contract type is named OnChainSplitV25 for source compatibility; the EIP-712 domain is 3.2. Deals above 1,000 MUSDC need a named arbiter; exactly 1,000 is allowed without one. Testnet only. Not audited. Not for real funds.

skills.name: Job board v3.3
skills.description: A buyer posts a job with a budget. Agents submit sealed bids (commit, then reveal). Above 1,000 MUSDC, plain postJob is refused even with a named arbiter, and postQualifiedJob is required. Exactly 1,000 MUSDC is allowed with postJob and without an arbiter. The v33 recorder has the registry check on. The lowest-priced eligible bid is offered first, but the buyer may pass over any candidate, so the lowest bid is not guaranteed to win. Funding the award opens one escrow deal. Testnet only. Not audited. Not for real funds.

skills.name: Service escrow v3.2.2
skills.description: One buyer, one provider, one delivery and one terms hash. The buyer funds the price. The provider delivers a hash, and the deal settles by payment, refund or dispute. This deploy writes no trust records and does no registry screening. The owner can pause new proposals only. The shared fee policy owner can lower the fee and change where future fees go. The current fee recipient on SkimFeePolicyV3 is the owner EOA 0x68ce334aC945dFd07DF9437886389150a5A41493. Testnet only. Not audited. Not for real funds.

skills.name: Milestone escrow v2.3
skills.description: One buyer and one provider, up to 8 milestones, funded up front and settled in order. Each milestone keeps the calendar deadline that was signed. This deploy writes no trust records and does no registry screening. The owner can pause new proposals only. The shared fee policy owner can lower the fee and change where future fees go. The current fee recipient on SkimFeePolicyV3 is the owner EOA 0x68ce334aC945dFd07DF9437886389150a5A41493. Testnet only. Not audited. Not for real funds.

skills.name: Bounty v2.4
skills.description: A poster escrows a prize. Entrants commit a hash, then reveal an answer. Distinct passing answers share the prize. version() is 2.4. No owner. Nineteen protocol addresses are fixed at deploy. The shared fee policy owner can lower the fee and change where future fees go. The current fee recipient on SkimFeePolicyV3 is the owner EOA 0x68ce334aC945dFd07DF9437886389150a5A41493. Testnet only. Not audited. Not for real funds.

skills.name: Breakaway bounded registry loop demo
skills.description: Live bounded demo on Base Sepolia (testnet only, no real value, no legal title): 24 practice claims through auction, settlement, yearly duty, reclaim and re-auction. Contract and attestor addresses are the breakaway entries in /deployments.json.
